description_en: Retrieves the original payload of a vulnerability event
description_zh: 获取漏洞事件的原始 Payload
name: DescribeInvadeEventPayload

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the caller
parameters.help_zh: 调用方的源 IP 地址
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The language of the request and response. Valid values: - zh: Chinese. - en: English
parameters.help_zh: 请求和接收消息的语言类型。-zh：中文-en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time range during which the event occurred. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 事件发生时间范围的开始时间，秒级时间戳
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the time range during which the event occurred. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 事件发生时间范围的结束时间，秒级时间戳
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The public IP address of the asset where the intrusion event occurred
parameters.help_zh: 发生入侵事件资产的公网 IP 地址
parameters.name: public_ip

parameters.help_en: The private IP address of the asset where the intrusion event occurred
parameters.help_zh: 发生入侵事件资产的私网 IP 地址
parameters.name: private_ip

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the asset where the intrusion event occurred
parameters.help_zh: 发生入侵事件的资产实例 ID
parameters.name: assets_instance_id

AssetsInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the asset to which the event belongs
AssetsInstanceId.description_zh: 事件所属资产的实例 ID

HighlightEnd.description_en: The end position (character index) of the matched content in the payload
HighlightEnd.description_zh: 命中内容在 Payload 中的结束位置（字符下标）

HighlightStart.description_en: The start position (character index) of the matched content in the payload
HighlightStart.description_zh: 命中内容在 Payload 中的起始位置（字符下标）

Payload.description_en: The original packet payload of the intrusion event
Payload.description_zh: 入侵事件的原始报文 Payload 内容

PayloadLen.description_en: The length of the payload in bytes
